It carries the whole disk-boundary re-derivation battery: the verdict, the gate rows against their gate-time digests, the totals, the published seal manifest, the paper legs and every rendered transcript line are all re-derived FROM THE BYTES ON DISK, and each of those has an in-run twin gate that carries a mutant
